title: Same Story, Different Lens: A Multi-Agent System for Cross-Outlet News Framing Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.35208v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: News outlets covering the same event differ in what they emphasize and omit. \textit{Same Story, Different Lens} is an experimental research prototype for comparing these choices. It collects world and politics coverage from 17 outlets, groups reports about the same event, and produces structured analyses of sentiment, political lean, framing, loaded language, possible omissions, and model-estimated proportions of factual claims and opinion. Loaded-language entries include quotations and neutral rewordings. Three model roles (agents) handle article analysis, assessment of source support, and cross-outlet briefing generation. Analyses are stored in a JSONL archive. The evaluation compares outlet-level lean estimates with approximate, predefined reference ratings and summarizes the Critic's model-assigned grounding scores. translated_title: 同一个故事，不同的视角：一个用于跨媒体新闻框架分析的多智能体系统
translated_abstract: 报道同一事件的不同新闻媒体在内容侧重点和遗漏方面存在差异。《同一个故事，不同的视角》是一个用于比较这些差异的实验性研究原型。该系统收集17家媒体的世界与政治新闻报道，将关于同一事件的报道进行分组，并生成结构化分析，涵盖情感倾向、政治立场、报道框架、倾向性用语、可能的遗漏内容，以及模型估算的事实性陈述与观点的占比。倾向性用语条目包含原文引用和中性改写版本。三个模型角色（智能体）分别负责文章分析、来源支持度评估以及跨媒体简报生成。分析结果以JSONL档案形式存储。在评估方面，该系统将媒体层面的立场估计与近似的预设参考评级进行比较，并汇总评论者模型给出的依据评分。这些指标提供了初步的诊断参考。依据评分反映的是模型对源材料支持性内容的评估。
tldr: 本文提出一个多智能体研究原型系统，通过分析17家新闻媒体对同一事件的报道，在情感、政治立场、框架、倾向性用语及可能遗漏等维度上实现跨媒体新闻框架的对比分析。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a multi-agent research prototype that compares how 17 news outlets frame the same events by analyzing sentiment, political lean, framing, loaded language, and possible omissions in their coverage.
